description:
Guilds: a tag, a leader, officers and members, with private rooms in
    the hive and a page at /g/<tag>. No op reads: nothing is every guild, a
    tag is that guild (who is on, the servers they're on with join links),
    a wallet alone is its guilds and invites. op:
    create|edit|pin|join|leave|disband|accept|decline|invite|kick|promote|
    demote|lead|link|unlink|wear on `tag`, with args (create {name, line, door,
    emblem, discord}; a wallet op {wallet}; wear {on} picks the tag games show
    over you). `link` makes an invite link: the code
    comes back once, keep it; join with `code` to use one. Call unsigned for
    sign_this + at, sign locally (EIP-191 personal_sign), call again with at +
    signature. Rosters are public; nothing here holds a key or moves money.
name: guilds
